name: Hand in
description: Hand in a new version (SCOPE R5): files (dragged in or added one by one, up to 5, each uploaded privately, in turn), a link, or written or pasted text, with an optional note for Richard. A file of a kind not on the list, over 50 MB, or past the fifth is not added, and a sentence names it; handIn checks every file again and has the last word. 'Also add to My creations' is shown, switched off, until DBU-09.
